title: Analysts Size Up Lost Silver Output From Zacatecas Strike
content: A follow-up research note from a commodities desk tallies the silver output lost during the recently resolved Zacatecas mine strike, estimating the impact at under 0.1% of global annual mine supply -- too small on its own to move prices materially, the note concludes, though it flags the episode as a reminder of Mexico's outsized role in global supply.
